active_dedupe: Same business key and scope returns the same execution while dedupe_active is 1, including pending executions.
expiry: Explicit key expiry disables deduplication and does not fence pending work.
receipts: Execution receipts and immutable effect history survive client restart and object deletion for the complete fixture lifetime.
lookup: Content searches can be incomplete, stale or ambiguous; matching content is not operation identity.
authorization: Cancellation revokes new mutation admission; pre-admitted work may settle. Read-only reconciliation stays authorized.
observation: Harness drains every admitted execution after client exit before independent read-only checks.
identity_recovery: Only the recovered-identity control grants a unique authoritative index for the original request and scope.
